title: Chronon3D Render Plan V3 Shape and Gradient Extensions
description: Strict V3 extension contract. Existing V2 fields are validated against the unchanged V2 schema after extension fields are projected out.

animator_property_track.description: V3 override of the V2 animator property track. The property vocabulary is the V2 set plus the per-glyph 'rotation' and 'fill_color' tracks; V2 plans keep the frozen V2 enum and cannot use them.

property.description: stroke_width and stroke_color animate a shape's solid stroke. shadow_N_opacity, shadow_N_blur, shadow_N_offset_x, shadow_N_offset_y, and shadow_N_color animate the Nth shape style shadow, zero-based.

fill_gradient_animation.description: Each keyframe contains a complete fill GradientDefinition. Color-stop colors are authored in sRGB; colors and opacity are interpolated over the union of sorted stop positions, geometry is linearly interpolated, and type and spread remain fixed for the track. The base shape.fill must also be a gradient of the same type and spread. Interpolation uses the standard linear temporal easing by default.

masks.description: Ordered mask stack. The first entry seeds the stack and must use add; later operations compose alpha in declaration order. Difference is the symmetric difference of alpha coverage.
